:::{#sol-matrix-addition-practice}

Both [matrices](#def-matrix) are $2 \times 2$, so the [matrix sum](#def-matrix-addition) is defined:

$$
\ba
\matr{A} + \matr{B}
&= \begin{bmatrix} 1 + 3 & -1 + 2 \\ 2 + (-2) & 0 + 5 \end{bmatrix}
&& \text{(add entry by entry)}
\\
&= \begin{bmatrix} 4 & 1 \\ 0 & 5 \end{bmatrix}.
&& \text{(add)}
\ea
$$

:::
